journey.name: wear remove wallet cancel
journey.description:
Cancelling Remove wallet keeps the wallet: the dialog closes, and after a restart the watch still opens on Balance with a balance, not on onboarding. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Restored wallet. Backend: hosted regtest. The test wallet is public and its balance can change at any time, so the journey expects a balance above 0, not the amount it started with. Read the screen size once with `adb shell wm size` and use the swipe written for it: 454 px (`Wear_Large_Round_API37`) or 384 px (`Wear_Small_Round_API34`); for another size scale it as in README › What differs.

actions.action: Swipe the pager left: on a 454 px screen `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`, on a 384 px screen `adb shell input swipe 340 192 50 192 300`
Verify the dialog: the text "Remove wallet?" with ✕ (tag "WatchSettingsRemoveCancel")
Verify the dialog is gone: "WatchSettingsRemoveCancel" is not listed
Dump `android layout` every 5 s until it lists "WatchHomeBalance", for up to 1 minute
